in_marathi.name: Mandala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mandala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hinduism, Mandala represents the cosmos and the universe. It is a sacred symbol used in rituals, art, and meditation. The intricate designs of the Mandala symbolize harmony, unity, and the interconnectedness of all things.
